modules.title: Features
modules.intro: This deployment includes the capabilities below. Enable them after configuring their required connections.
modules.absentHelp: Ask a developer to add this module to the application composition and deploy it.
modules.disableHelp: Disabling a capability stops new business operations and hides its user entry points. Data is retained. Dependent capabilities become unavailable. Refunds, cancellation and existing obligations remain accessible. Re-enabling sharing makes previously shared links public again unless they were revoked.
modules.connectionsHelp: Connections provide technical services to features. Changing a connection does not enable a business capability.
modules.overviewHelp: Open an enabled capability, or configure features and service connections.
modules.sharingHelp: The sharing switch controls all public links. Revoke an individual link to keep it private after sharing is enabled again.
